question: What explains impressions that appear only in illness in those oriented toward isolation?
premises: Some impressions never appear in good health.
In those oriented toward isolation, such impressions may appear during illness.
Their manifestation is attributed to the descent of power.
inference: Not all illness-time manifestations are merely pathological; some signal the operation of the descent of power.
uncertainties: kaivalyabhāgīyāḥ can indicate those destined for or oriented toward kaivalya; the nuance is doctrinal.
plain_english: But in those oriented toward isolation, some impressions never appear in good health and yet open up in illness. These arise from the descent of power.
